Native JavaScript · Web Worker
Drop your GLB to open it

Blender workflow, in your browser.

This application ports the supplied Décimation LowPoly / AR 1.1.0 workflow to JavaScript. Geometry processing is performed locally in a worker. It does not run Blender and is not a bit-identical translation of Blender’s native modifiers.

Plugin stageBrowser implementation
CollapseQuadric-error edge collapse with topology tests, interpolated vertex attributes and optional paired axis symmetry.
PlanarConnected planar regions, UV/material/normal boundaries, shared boundary dissolve, and hole-aware retriangulation.
Auto smoothEdge-connected smoothing fans split at the selected angle.
Weighted normalArea × corner-angle weights, retaining the chosen sharp boundaries. Blender’s weight-50 contrast is not reproduced exactly.
LowPoly / ARWorld-preserving _LOD/_LOW helpers or a cleaned _AR copy of the selected hierarchy.

Using the workspace

Open a GLB, select a mesh or parent hierarchy, choose the output and engine, and press Generate. Selecting an existing LOW or AR mesh processes that generated copy again. Regenerating from an original starts from the original geometry. Undo restores the previous transaction. Delete generated restores the source hierarchy and leaves original mesh buffers intact.

Exports and supported input

Standard self-contained GLB 2.0 files with PNG/JPEG/WebP textures are supported. Draco, Meshopt and KTX2/Basis compressed assets are rejected with an explicit message. Animation and skeletal/morph meshes are imported as a static loaded-pose snapshot; rigs and animation are not exported. GPU instances are expanded into individual static mesh nodes. Point and line primitives are excluded.

Optimized only exports the low version plus untouched source parts, or the generated AR hierarchy. High + low hierarchy exports both alternatives in groups, not an automatic distance-switching LOD extension. Both geometries overlap by design in that package; show only one in your DCC. The viewer never draws both alternatives over one another.

Quality safeguards

UV preservation does not mean texture rebaking: collapse interpolates retained attributes, and can change texture interpolation as geometry changes. Planar dissolve rejects regions whose existing UV mapping is not sufficiently affine. Protected seams, non-manifold regions and open borders may stop reduction before the requested target. No global self-intersection repair or watertightness guarantee is made.

Symmetry is about the original mesh-local zero plane, not its bounding-box center. Unmatched vertices are protected. The planar deviation and UV tolerance controls are additional safeguards not present in the original plugin.

Privacy and dependencies

No uploads, CDN requests, accounts or server are used. The HTML embeds Three.js r165, its GLTFLoader and OrbitControls, Earcut, and the custom processing/export code. Open the file directly in a current desktop browser with WebGL2 and Web Workers enabled.
